faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about PR.SOCIAL
faq_g1_a: PR.SOCIAL is a social media platform where you earn money by completing simple tasks — follows, likes, comments, and views — on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, and X (Twitter).
faq_g2_a: Yes, registration is completely free. You earn money by completing tasks — no investment needed, no subscription fees, no hidden charges.
faq_g3_a: We support 18 platforms: Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, X (Twitter), Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, Reddit, Quora, Snapchat, Likee, GitHub, Discord, Kick, Google Maps, Trustpilot, and MAX. New platforms are added regularly.
faq_g4_a: Yes. PR.SOCIAL connects real people who voluntarily complete social media tasks. No bots, fake accounts, or unauthorized automation. All actions are performed manually or through official tools (App, Extension, API).
faq_e1_a:
1. Create a free account
2. Go to Profile and link your social media accounts
3. Wait for account verification (usually takes a few minutes)
4. Browse available tasks and start completing them
5. Your balance updates automatically after each approved task
faq_e2_q: How much can I earn per task?
faq_e2_a: Rewards vary by action type. Likes: $0.002 per task. Follows, comments, subscriptions, and other actions: $0.004 per task. Earnings depend on how many tasks you complete.
faq_e3_a: After completing a task, you upload a screenshot as proof. Our team reviews it to confirm the action was performed correctly. If approved, your balance is credited automatically. If rejected, you'll see the reason and can try again.
faq_e4_a: Most tasks are verified within 2–5 minutes. During peak hours it may take slightly longer, but we aim to review all submissions as quickly as possible.
faq_e5_q: Can I link multiple social accounts?
faq_e5_a: You can link one account per platform. For example, one Instagram account, one YouTube account, and so on. All 18 supported platforms can be linked simultaneously. Each account is verified individually.
faq_p1_q: How do I promote my account?
faq_p1_a:
1. Go to 'Create Order' in the menu
2. Select the platform and action type (follow, like, comment, etc.)
3. Enter the target URL (your profile or post link)
4. Choose the quantity
5. Confirm and pay from your balance

Real users will start completing your tasks immediately.
faq_p2_a: Prices start from $0.01 per action. The exact price depends on the platform and action type. You see the total cost before confirming your order — no surprises.
faq_p3_a: Yes, 100%. Every action is performed by a real person from their personal account. Each task requires a screenshot proof that is manually verified. We have zero tolerance for bots or fake engagement.
faq_p4_q: How fast will I see results?
faq_p4_a: Results start appearing within minutes after creating an order, depending on the number of available workers. Most orders are completed within a few hours.
faq_w1_q: How do I withdraw my earnings?
faq_w1_a: Go to Wallet → Withdraw. Minimum: $2 for USDT BEP-20 and Toncoin, $5 for TRX. Fee: 0%. Processing time: 24–48 hours.
faq_w2_q: How do I add funds to my balance?
faq_w2_a: Go to Wallet and click 'Deposit'. Payment methods are being expanded and will include cryptocurrency, bank cards, and popular payment systems.
faq_w3_a: The minimum withdrawal amount is $5. There is no platform fee — you receive the full amount. Blockchain network fees may apply depending on the method.
faq_r1_q: How does the referral program work?
faq_r1_a: Share your unique referral link with friends. When they sign up and complete tasks, you earn 10% of their task earnings automatically. This is passive income — it continues for as long as they are active on the platform.
faq_r2_q: Is there a limit on referral earnings?
faq_r2_a: No limits! You can invite as many people as you want, and you'll earn 10% from each of their task completions with no cap.
faq_r3_q: Where do I find my referral link?
faq_r3_a: Go to the 'Referrals' page in the sidebar menu. Your unique link and referral code are displayed there, along with statistics on your referrals and earnings.
faq_s1_q: What happens if my screenshot is rejected?
faq_s1_a: You'll see the rejection reason (e.g., 'action not visible', 'screenshot cropped'). You can resubmit with a better screenshot. Tips: use full-screen captures, make sure your username and the completed action are clearly visible.
faq_s2_a: Yes. PR.SOCIAL has a warning system: 3 warnings = account suspension. Warnings are issued for: multi-accounting, fake task completions, spam, or other rule violations. You can read the full list in the Platform Rules section.
faq_s3_a: We only store your email and linked social media usernames. Passwords are encrypted. We never access your social media accounts directly — you perform all actions yourself.

guide_link_title: How to Link a Social Account
guide_link_intro: Follow these steps to link and verify your social media account:
guide_step1_text: Navigate to your Profile page from the sidebar. Scroll down to the "Social Media Accounts" section.
guide_step2_text: Click on any unlinked platform (e.g. Instagram, YouTube, TikTok). You can link one account per platform.
guide_step3_text: Enter your social media username and profile URL. Make sure your profile is PUBLIC — private profiles cannot be verified.
guide_step4_text: PR.SOCIAL gives you a unique verification code (e.g. prs_7a3c19). Add this code to your bio or profile description on the social media platform.
guide_step5_text: Take a screenshot showing the verification code in your bio. The screenshot must clearly show the social platform interface with the code visible.
guide_step6_text: Upload your screenshot. AI verifies it automatically — usually instant. If AI is unsure, it goes to manual review by admin (within 1 hour). You get up to 3 AI attempts before automatic manual review.
guide_telegram_text: Telegram accounts are linked via the bot @prsocialfree_bot. No screenshot needed — just follow the bot's instructions.
guide_change_text: You cannot unlink accounts yourself. To change a linked account, go to Profile → click the account → Request Change. An admin reviews each request individually.
